Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE new high-end 2D collectible RPG splash illustration of 족로, SSS LIMITED quality. Portrait 2:3, native 1024x1536 or higher. An intentional beautiful character artwork, no poster text, UI, name, grade, border or watermark.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1 is 족로 IDENTITY / FACE / BLACK TOKKO-FUKU COSTUME / EMERALD DRAGON reference, not its rejected wide-legged crouch. Image 2 is the official C9 emblem design. Image 3 is a STANDING POSE / UPRIGHT COMPOSURE reference ONLY: do NOT copy that man's face, long hair, white robes, golden armor, long Chinese sword, gold colors or blossom setting.
Keep the SAME recognizable handsome adult face, clean sharp jaw, narrow emerald eyes, short black hair identity as image 1. Coherent refined 2D anime drawing plus delicate painterly shading across face, neck, hands, hair and clothes; no photoreal face graft, no 3D render.
HAIR FIX: natural clean matte black hair, soft connected root-to-tip flow with a modest loose part, readable fine strands and a few flyaways. LESS density of shiny crisscross threads; no wet/greasy clumps, noodle tangles, broad glossy bands, spikes stacked in tiers or blade/ribbon layers. Same haircut and black color, not long hair.
COSTUME: same original Japanese tokko-fuku black high-collar long coat, silver buttons and trim, subtle emerald dragon embroidery inside lining, fitted black shirt, ordinary belted black trousers and flat black boots. Elegant restrained fabric drift, legs clearly coherent under coat, not a huge skirt. Keep costume tailoring recognizable.
LOGO FIX: use the reference 2 crowned spotted white feline above the interlocking C and 9 as a small premium EMBROIDERED UNIT PATCH integrated into visible outer upper sleeve. Entire emblem sits INSIDE a compact dark charcoal/emerald cloth shield with a little breathing space, thin silver/green stitched border and natural fabric curvature. Clear recognizable logo, thread texture, shared sleeve lighting, no shiny sticker. No separate "C9" lettering below or near it. No floating logo. Patch fits comfortably on upper sleeve.
ILLUSTRATION STILL THREE KATANA: one held by the diamond-WRAPPED HANDLE between teeth, two held one per hand. No mouth blade, guard clearly outside cheek. Closed natural hand grips, thumb opposed to four fingers around each handle, no extra digit, wrist and forearm aligned. Single rigid smooth weapon construction from handle through circular tsuba into blade, no zigzag/kinks/disconnected axes. Japanese katana design, subtle graceful curvature, steel and restrained emerald edge reflections; NORMAL moderately short 65–70cm blades with 24cm hilts on a 180cm adult, NOT nodachi/long European swords, no exaggerated blade length. Compose natural sword directions, tips can naturally leave frame but never bend to fit. The user's separate one-katana iaido change is for battle sprites, NOT this three-sword illustration.
POSE CONSTRAINTS: standing tall comfortably, torso upright, no squat/lunge/spread stance. Feet about hip-to-shoulder width maximum, one foot can be a half-step ahead, knees essentially straight with natural soft relaxation. No absurdly wide thighs or huge foreground shoe. Legs natural length/proportions, not bodybuilder bulk.
DRAGON / LIGHT: enormous fierce emerald Eastern dragon from image1, wingless serpent, strong opaque detailed dark-jade scales, long whiskers, antler horns, spiked mane, green eyes and fanged snout. Coil behind torso and wind around lower foreground, head visible above/right, face/hands/logo/swords unobscured. Rich GREEN aura filaments, green flame along scales, sparks and sharp emerald eye gleam. Green is the sole strong magical hue; no gold dragon, yellow/blue lightning, muddy haze or whole-screen white flash. Nighttime high city terrace with deep atmospheric skyline and storm clouds, cohesive refined painted depth. No borrowed white robe or golden armor.
VARIANT B — USER'S STANDING-REFERENCE DIRECTION: closely follow image 3's calm elegant upright full-body THREE-QUARTER SIDE COMPOSITION and weight distribution. Head, chest and gaze turn about 35–40 degrees toward SCREEN RIGHT; long relaxed vertical torso, settled hips, modest narrow step rather than a fight lunge. Near arm on SCREEN LEFT hangs naturally, hand around katana hilt near upper thigh, blade angles down toward lower right at normal length. Far arm on SCREEN RIGHT bends gently outward at waist like the open-hand arm in image3, but close its hand naturally around the SECOND katana's hilt; its blade points gently down and out to the right, unobstructed and clearly separate from first. Preserve the THIRD mouth-held katana, hilt at teeth and blade extending right. Adapt arm spacing only as required for those three distinct swords; don't give him an empty palm. Face and C9 patch clearly visible. Coat hangs mostly vertical with a gentle leftward flow, legs comfortably aligned beneath body, no deep crouch or wide spread. The emerald dragon loops behind shoulders and torso in a sophisticated sweeping spiral echoing image3, fierce green head above his forward shoulder. A serene overwhelming master-swordsman presence, not a braced combat squat. Copy posture language only; retain original BLACK SHORT HAIR / BLACK TOKKO-FUKU / GREEN DRAGON identity.
